content:
When I first started working on this guide, my goal was simple: help new players progress smoothly without getting lost in all the mechanics.

In this guide, I break down how to move from World 1 to World 6 efficiently, while also preparing for the future worlds ahead. Before entering the “Fixing Phase” (a skill backtracking stage I’ll cover in my next guide), you’ll have a clear roadmap that keeps your journey fluid and focused.

What makes me proud is that I didn’t write this guide alone in a bubble - I tested it while accompanying players step by step. And the results? Some of them managed to reach World 6 in just one week by following it. 🚀

⚡ These are explosive progressions, but more importantly, this guide gives you a blueprint : a proven path to follow, so your climb to World 6 feels steady, rewarding, and structured.

If you’re just starting out, or if you’ve been feeling stuck, this might be the push you need to finally break through.

👉  https://my.visme.co/view/dwonr73g-idleon-academy-the-beginning 

Next up: the “Fixing” guide, where we’ll dive into optimizing skills and backtracking efficiently.

I’ve just finished implementing the feedback I received on the guide, and here are the main changes:

- Companions matter → I added a dedicated section to highlight their importance.

- Poppy reference → included a link to the Poppy guide (as I mentioned from the start, I’m not covering skill optimization in this guide).

- Divinity & Lab → I emphasized that unlocking Gotharu should be the top priority, which makes it logical to focus on Divinity before going back to Lab.

- Style choice → I’m keeping the current graphic style. I know it won’t please everyone, but it’s clear enough to read and that’s what matters most for me.
